domestic.comment: 9/15(화) 코스피는 '검은 월요일'(-3.26%)의 충격에서 반등을 시도했으나 결국 6,627.26(-0.85%)로 마감하며 이틀 연속 하락했습니다. 장중 6,582까지 밀렸다가 낙폭을 일부 만회했지만 6,600대 초반에 안착했습니다. 삼성전자(+0.80%)·SK하이닉스(+1.18%)가 반등을 시도했고, 코스닥은 812.41(+0.70%)로 상대적으로 선방했습니다. 원/달러는 1,363원대로 원화 약세가 이어졌고, 외국인 투매 진정 여부가 관건입니다.

overseas.keyStocks: 美 증시는 FOMC 경계감과 AI 안전 우려로 2일 연속 하락했습니다(S&P -0.45%·Dow -0.58%·Nasdaq -0.11%). 10년물 국채금리는 장중 5%를 돌파해 2007년 이후 최고치를 기록했고, WTI $105·Brent $108로 유가 쇼크가 지속됐습니다. VIX는 16.84(-1.52%)로 소폭 진정됐고, DAX +0.82%·FTSE +0.39%로 유럽은 상대적 강세를 보였습니다.

morning.insight:
📅 오늘 밤 FOMC 금리 결정 — '인상 vs 동결'보다 '그 이후'가 중요

어제(9/15) 코스피는 검은 월요일 충격에서 반등을 시도했지만(삼성전자 +0.80%·SK하이닉스 +1.18%) 결국 6,627.26(-0.85%)로 이틀 연속 하락 마감했습니다. 美 10년물 금리 5% 돌파와 유가 $108이 맞물린 스태그플레이션 공포가 시장을 짓누르고 있습니다.

핵심 변수 3가지:
1. FOMC 인상 vs 점도표 — 25bp 인상은 89% pricing(재료 소멸 가능성), 동결(11%) 서프라이즈 시 강한 Risk-On 랠리. 워시 의장의 점도표·기자회견 톤이 '일회성 vs 추가 인상' 방향을 결정
2. 유가 $105~108 — 사우디 파이프라인 이슈가 일시적이라면 진정 가능, 후티 추가 공격 여부 주목
3. AI 안전 규제 — Amodei 'We Must Pace the Frontier' → 규제 시 소형·오픈소스 모델 비용 증가, AI 안전·보안 스타트업 수혜

FOMC 결과(한국시간 9/17 새벽) 확인 전까지 현금 비중 유지 + 변동성 매수 분산 전략이 유효해 보입니다.

articles.headline: The Unrelenting Bond Selloff Puts the 10-Year Yield on the Cusp of 5%
articles.eng: Unrelenting bond selloff puts the 10-year yield on the cusp of 5%
articles.body: A persistent bond selloff pushed the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield to the cusp of 5% amid inflation fears, its highest level since 2007.

articles.headline: Odds of Fed Rate Hike in September Hit 70%
articles.eng: Odds of a September Fed rate hike hit 70%
articles.body: Investors priced in a 70% chance of a September Fed hike, up from 37% a week earlier, as escalating Middle East tensions pushed oil prices higher.

articles.headline: Stocks Fall in Run-Up to Fed as Yields Stay High
articles.eng: Stocks fall in run-up to Fed as yields stay high
articles.body: Wall Street traders refrained from riskier bets in the countdown to the Federal Reserve decision, with stocks falling as elevated oil prices and bond yields weighed on sentiment.

articles.headline: Gold Holds Losses as Higher Oil Stokes September Rate-Hike Bets
articles.eng: Gold holds losses as higher oil stokes September rate-hike bets
articles.body: Oil's surge stoked inflation fears and pushed bond yields higher, with traders now pricing in about a 95% chance the Fed hikes rates this week.

articles.headline: Stocks Rise as Attention Shifts to Next Week's Fed Rate Decision
articles.eng: Stocks rise as attention shifts to the Fed rate decision
articles.body: US stocks rallied as retreating oil prices offered relief following a report showing accelerating core inflation, which led traders to boost bets on a Fed hike.

articles.headline: Oil Surges as Saudi Arabia Shuts Down Major Crude Pipeline
articles.eng: Oil surges as Saudi Arabia shuts down major crude pipeline
articles.body: Oil prices jumped after Saudi Arabia closed a major crude pipeline following attacks, with an Iran-Gulf meeting postponed amid regional tensions.

articles.headline: Fed, BOE and BOJ Decisions in Focus
articles.eng: Fed, BOE and BOJ decisions in focus
articles.body: Central banks take center stage this week, with the Federal Reserve decision due Wednesday against a backdrop of an AI-selloff, rising oil and elevated yields.

articles.headline: Amodei: 'In 6-12 Months a Swarm Could Take Over the Entire Internet'
articles.eng: Amodei warns a swarm could take over the internet within 6-12 months
articles.body: The Anthropic CEO warned that within 6-12 months an AI swarm could be capable of taking over the entire internet, citing embedded evaluators and global coordination as needed safeguards.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia's Oil 'Lifeline' Was Attacked by a Drone Strike From Iraq
articles.eng: Saudi Arabia's oil 'lifeline' was attacked by a drone strike from Iraq
articles.body: A drone attack from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to close its East-West pipeline, the kingdom's vital oil export artery, deepening global supply concerns.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Shudder in Response to Calls to Slow A.I. Progress
articles.eng: Tech stocks shudder in response to calls to slow A.I. progress
articles.body: Companies at the forefront of artificial intelligence posted declines after tech leaders expressed worries about 'frontier' A.I. technology.

articles.headline: What Anthropic's C.E.O. Argued in His Call for Slower A.I. Development
articles.eng: What Anthropic's C.E.O. argued in his call for slower A.I. development
articles.body: Dario Amodei laid out A.I.'s rapidly advancing capabilities and said greater safety controls were needed.

articles.headline: Is A.I. Raising the Chances of Biological Warfare?
articles.eng: Is A.I. raising the chances of biological warfare?
articles.body: Researchers examine whether rapidly advancing A.I. tools lower the barriers to engineering dangerous biological agents.

articles.headline: Meeting Between Iran and Arab States Is Postponed as Mideast Diplomacy Stalls
articles.eng: Iran-Arab states meeting postponed as Mideast diplomacy stalls
articles.body: Diplomatic efforts to de-escalate the regional conflict have stalled as an Iran-Gulf meeting is postponed.

articles.headline: The Houthis Are Increasingly Using Artificial Intelligence in Attacks
articles.eng: Houthis are increasingly using artificial intelligence in attacks
articles.body: The Houthis are increasingly turning to artificial intelligence in their operations, including strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure, according to reporting.

articles.headline: Onstage Call With Nvidia CEO, Trump Deems AI Fears a 'Hoax'
articles.eng: Onstage call with Nvidia CEO, Trump deems AI fears a 'hoax'
articles.body: President Trump, appearing alongside Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, dismissed warnings about AI dangers as a 'hoax,' rejecting calls to slow the technology's development.

articles.headline: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Discussed Creating New AI Safety Body
articles.eng: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google discussed creating a new AI safety body
articles.body: Leading AI companies held discussions about creating a new industry body focused on AI safety, as alarms over the technology's rapid advance mount.

articles.headline: Top AI Leaders Unite to Warn the Technology Is Advancing Too Fast
articles.eng: Top AI leaders unite to warn the technology is advancing too fast
articles.body: Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and Elon Musk, long at odds with each other, found common ground in calling for a slowdown in the advancement of AI amid mounting fears about its dangers.

articles.headline: King Charles to Host AI Leaders as Disaster Warnings Mount
articles.eng: King Charles to host AI leaders as disaster warnings mount
articles.body: King Charles III is set to host AI leaders, a meeting that has taken on new urgency amid alarms being sounded from inside the industry.

articles.headline: China Pushes Back on Calls for an AI Slowdown as Trump-Xi Meeting Looms
articles.eng: China pushes back on calls for an AI slowdown as Trump-Xi meeting looms
articles.body: Beijing has pushed back against calls to slow AI development, positioning itself to accelerate as the US debates the technology's risks.

articles.headline: Pacing an AI Frontier Does Not Require Government—Labs Can Do It
articles.eng: Pacing an AI frontier does not require government—labs can do it
articles.body: An opinion piece argues that AI labs themselves, rather than government regulators, are best positioned to pace the frontier of AI development responsibly.

articles.headline: Warsh and Trump on Collision Course as Investors Expect Fed to Raise Rates
articles.eng: Warsh and Trump on collision course as investors expect Fed to raise rates
articles.body: Fed chair Kevin Warsh is under pressure to back warnings on inflation with action, risking the president's ire as markets prepare for the central bank to raise rates.

articles.headline: Middle East War Day 16: Oil Prices Jump Nearly 3%
articles.eng: Oil prices jump nearly 3% on day 16 of the Middle East war
articles.body: Oil prices jumped almost 3% as Asian markets opened, with Brent rising to $105.61 a barrel amid the escalating regional conflict.

articles.headline: Kevin Warsh to Stick With Lean Fed Messaging Despite Market Backlash
articles.eng: Kevin Warsh to stick with lean Fed messaging despite market backlash
articles.body: Kevin Warsh is set to stick to his stripped-back communications style even after the Fed chair's decision to offer scant details drew market criticism.

articles.headline: 'Worst' Still Ahead as Oil Price Swings Darken Global Trade Outlook
articles.eng: 'Worst' still ahead as oil price swings darken global trade outlook
articles.body: Analysts warn the worst may be yet to come, estimating that sustained high oil prices could shave 0.5 percentage points off growth in 2026.

articles.headline: Will Kevin Warsh Offer Any Clues on Fed Rates Outlook?
articles.eng: Will Kevin Warsh offer any clues on Fed rates outlook?
articles.body: Minutes of Warsh's first meeting indicate many Fed rate setters were concerned about current levels of inflation, raising questions about the path ahead.

articles.headline: Kevin Warsh Seeks to Reassure Investors as US Economic Strains Mount
articles.eng: Kevin Warsh seeks to reassure investors as US economic strains mount
articles.body: Warsh has drastically reduced guidance on future interest rates, seeking to reassure investors even as economic strains build.
